description: Question-Answer pairs for evaluating RAG retrieval quality. Based on TechMart knowledge base.

data.question: What is the return window for hardware products?
data.answer: 30 days from the delivery date

data.question: How long does a refund take to appear on a credit card?
data.answer: 5 to 10 business days after the item is received

data.question: Can I get a refund on activated software?
data.answer: No, digital downloads and activated software are non-refundable

data.question: How do I initiate a return for a product?
data.answer: Log into your account, go to Orders, select the order, click Return Item, choose a reason, and print the prepaid return shipping label

data.question: What is the price of TechMart Pro X1 laptop?
How much RAM does the Creator C5 have?
data.answer: 32 GB

data.question: Is the TechMart SmartWatch S3 currently in stock?
data.answer: No, it is currently out of stock with expected restock in Q3 2024

data.question: What GPU does the TechMart Creator C5 have?
data.answer: NVIDIA RTX 4070

data.question: What is the monthly price of TechMart Premium subscription?
data.answer: $19.99 per month

data.question: How do I reset my password?
data.answer: Go to techmart.com/login, click Forgot Password, enter your email address, and follow the link sent to your inbox

data.question: How long is an account locked after failed login attempts?
data.answer: 30 minutes after 5 failed login attempts

data.question: What should I do if the software crashes on launch?
data.answer: Update to the latest version, restart the computer, run in compatibility mode, or reinstall with a fresh copy

data.question: What operating systems are supported?
data.answer: Windows 10 or later, macOS 12 or later, and Ubuntu 20.04 or later

data.question: How do I do a factory reset on my laptop?
data.answer: On Windows: Settings > System > Recovery > Reset this PC. On macOS: Restart, hold Cmd+R, use Disk Utility to erase, then reinstall macOS. Warning: backs up data first.

data.question: What is covered under the standard TechMart warranty?
data.answer: Manufacturing defects and hardware failures under normal use for 1 year from purchase, including screen, battery degradation over 20%, and ports

data.question: Does the warranty cover physical damage from drops?
data.answer: No, physical damage from drops, spills, and cracks is not covered under the standard warranty

data.question: How much does TechMart Care Pro cost?
data.answer: $129 and includes 3 years of total coverage plus one accidental damage claim

data.question: What is the battery warranty policy?
data.answer: The battery is warranted to retain more than 80% capacity at 500 charge cycles or within 1 year. A free replacement is provided if it drops below 80%.

data.question: How much does express 2-day shipping cost?
At what order value does shipping become free?
data.answer: Orders over $50 qualify for free standard shipping

data.question: What is the TechMart support phone number?
data.answer: 1-800-TECHMART

data.question: What are TechMart support hours?
data.answer: Monday to Friday 9am to 6pm EST, and Saturday 10am to 4pm EST

data.question: How long does international shipping take to the UK?
data.answer: 10 to 14 days for standard shipping at $19.99, or 5 to 7 days for express at $39.99

data.question: What discount is available for students?
data.answer: 15% discount with a valid .edu email address

data.question: How do I claim a warranty on a defective product?
data.answer: Email warranty@techmart.com with your order number and photos or video of the defect. The team responds within 24 business hours.
